_note: Built-in instrument templates. Basis: the typical layout of each vendor's peak-table / library-search export as described in public material; they match this site's simulated example files and have NOT been checked against real exports. Mapping keys are normalized header texts (see mapping.js normHeader). 'optional' columns are mapped when present but are not needed for the template to match.
